title.en: 24 cards: Feyenoord, the left side, Rayo on Monday
title.es: 24 tarjetas: Feyenoord, la izquierda, Rayo el lunes

deck.en: Each card is a written summary of one story. Sources stay in their own language.
deck.es: Cada tarjeta es un resumen escrito de una historia. Las fuentes quedan en su idioma.

headline.en: Feyenoord at 18:45 on 9 September opens the league phase
headline.es: El Feyenoord a las 18:45 del 9 de septiembre abre la fase liga

summary.en: UEFA published the league-phase kickoff times on Saturday. Barcelona play Feyenoord at Camp Nou on 9 September at 18:45 CET, then Galatasaray away, Paris Saint-Germain away, Aston Villa at home, Sabah away, Manchester City at home, Sporting away and Como at home. The early midweek slot leaves less recovery after a Liga weekend. Squad depth will matter more on those dates than it does against Rayo.
summary.es: La UEFA publico el sabado los horarios de la fase liga. El Barca juega contra el Feyenoord en el Camp Nou el 9 de septiembre a las 18:45, y despues visita a Galatasaray y al PSG, recibe al Villa y al City, y cierra con Sporting y Como. El horario temprano deja menos descanso despues de Liga.

headline.en: Eric Garcia will miss Feyenoord after last season's red card
headline.es: Eric Garcia se pierde el Feyenoord por la roja de la temporada pasada

summary.en: Eric Garcia will miss the Champions League opener against Feyenoord because of a red card from last season. UEFA rule 63.01 carries a straight red into the next European match. He was sent off in the quarter-final second leg at Atletico Madrid. Jules Kounde and Xavi Espart are the options on that side.
summary.es: Eric Garcia se perdera el estreno de Champions ante el Feyenoord por una roja de la temporada pasada. El articulo 63.01 arrastra la expulsion. La vio en la vuelta de cuartos en el Metropolitano. Kounde y Xavi Espart cubren esa banda.

headline.en: Livakovic trained with the first team. Registration is still open
headline.es: Livakovic entrenó con el primer equipo. La ficha sigue abierta

summary.en: Dominik Livakovic signed until 2030 after a low fixed fee and add-ons to Fenerbahce. He trained with the first team on Saturday. Joan Garcia remains first choice. Whether he is registered for Liga and Europe or goes on loan depends on fair play.
summary.es: Dominik Livakovic firmo hasta 2030 por una cifra fija baja y variables al Fenerbahce. El sabado trabajo con el primer equipo. Joan Garcia sigue de titular. Si se inscribe o sale cedido lo decide el fair play.

headline.en: Rodri trained in the gym away from the main group
headline.es: Rodri trabajo en el gimnasio, fuera del grupo

summary.en: Rodri trained away from the main group again on Saturday and did gym work, according to SPORT at the Ciutat Esportiva. The club planned this load when he arrived after the World Cup. His minutes against Athletic Club were a first appearance, not proof that he is ready for a full week.
summary.es: Rodri volvio a trabajar al margen el sabado y hizo gimnasio, segun SPORT. El club diseño esa carga cuando llego despues del Mundial. Los minutos ante el Athletic fueron una primera aparicion.

headline.en: Atletico will not sell Alvarez. The decree is not a contract
headline.es: El Atletico no vende a Alvarez. El decreto no es un contrato

summary.en: Atletico Madrid still refuse to negotiate Julian Alvarez with Barcelona. Ramon Fuentes in Mundo Deportivo argues that decree 1006 would not automatically sanction a forced exit. That is a legal reading, not an agreement. Flick is working with Raphinha and Ferran Torres as the reference in attack.
summary.es: El Atletico sigue sin negociar a Julian Alvarez. Ramon Fuentes escribe que el decreto 1006 no sancionaria de forma automatica. Es un marco legal, no un pacto. Flick trabaja con Raphinha y Ferran.

headline.en: Barcelona host Rayo on Monday at 21:30. Gavi missed Saturday training
headline.es: El Barca recibe al Rayo el lunes a las 21:30. Gavi no entrenó el sabado

summary.en: Barcelona host Rayo Vallecano on Monday at 21:30. Mundo Deportivo reported that Livakovic joined Saturday's session and Gavi did not, after the knock he took at Elche. Pedri has already covered that role.
summary.es: El Barca recibe al Rayo el lunes a las 21:30. Mundo Deportivo conto que Livakovic si estuvo el sabado y Gavi no, tras el golpe de Elche. Pedri ya cubrio ese puesto.

headline.en: Venezia have a verbal deal for Toni Fernandez
headline.es: El Venezia tiene un acuerdo verbal por Toni Fernandez

summary.en: Venezia have a verbal agreement to sign Toni Fernandez for about four million euros. Fabrizio Romano reported a 50 percent sell-on clause and a buy-back. Fernandez is 18 and entering the last year of his contract. The sale sits with the earlier exits of Fort and Cortes.
summary.es: El Venezia tiene un acuerdo verbal por Toni Fernandez cerca de cuatro millones. Romano avanzo un 50 por ciento de futura venta y una opcion de recompra. Tiene 18 anos y entra en el ultimo ano de contrato.

headline.en: Raphinha is setting the height of the press without a centre-forward
headline.es: Raphinha marca la altura de la presion sin un delantero centro

summary.en: Mundo Deportivo described small changes in how Barcelona start the press without a classic centre-forward. Against Elche and Athletic, Raphinha set the height of the line rather than only stretching the wing. Rayo, who defend deep, will show on Monday whether those distances hold.
summary.es: Mundo Deportivo describio cambios en la presion sin un delantero centro clasico. Ante Elche y Athletic, Raphinha marco la altura de la linea. El Rayo dira el lunes si esas distancias se sostienen.

headline.en: Xavi Espart is registered with the first team and will wear 12
headline.es: Xavi Espart esta inscrito en el primer equipo y llevara el 12

summary.en: Barcelona have registered Xavi Espart as a first-team player with LaLiga and given him the number 12 shirt. He is 19. Flick started him at left-back in Elche after comparing him to Philipp Lahm, then used him higher up against Athletic.
summary.es: El Barca ha inscrito a Xavi Espart como jugador del primer equipo y le ha dado el dorsal 12. Tiene 19 anos. Flick lo alineo de lateral zurdo en Elche y lo movio por dentro ante el Athletic.

headline.en: Balde has decided to stay. He is not first choice on the left
headline.es: Balde ha decidido quedarse. No es titular en la izquierda

summary.en: Alejandro Balde has decided to stay at Barcelona until 2028 after being left out at Elche and after Flick discussed him in public. La Vanguardia reported that he asked for minutes. Joao Cancelo and Xavi Espart are currently ahead of him on the left.
summary.es: Alejandro Balde ha decidido quedarse hasta 2028 despues de Elche y de las palabras de Flick. La Vanguardia conto que pidio minutos. Cancelo y Espart van por delante en la izquierda.

headline.en: Cancelo is registered after leaving Al Hilal as a free agent
headline.es: Cancelo esta inscrito despues de salir libre del Al Hilal

summary.en: Joao Cancelo is now registered for Liga. Culemania listed him with Gordon, Adeyemi and Rodri as the four summer arrivals already on the list. Barcelona used the return to the 1:1 rule to complete those signings.
summary.es: Joao Cancelo ya esta inscrito en Liga. Culemania lo agrupa con Gordon, Adeyemi y Rodri. El Barca uso la vuelta al 1:1 para cerrarlos.

headline.en: Gordon's first start lasted 80 minutes and produced no goal or assist
headline.es: El primer once de Gordon duro 80 minutos y no tuvo gol ni asistencia

summary.en: Anthony Gordon made his first Barcelona start against Athletic Club and played 80 minutes. Goal and SPORT recorded three recoveries, five duels won from nine, three completed dribbles and two shots. Flick signed him as a high-press runner. Adeyemi replaced him late.
summary.es: Anthony Gordon hizo su primer once ante el Athletic y jugo 80 minutos. Goal y SPORT anotaron tres recuperaciones, cinco duelos de nueve, tres regates y dos tiros. Adeyemi le relevo al final.
